title: l9-meta-injector — zero failures, zero warnings, installable and runnable from a consumer repository
objective: Make Quantum-L9/l9-meta-injector green on every local and CI gate with no warnings, and prove by automated test that another repository can install it (GitHub Action, packed tarball, git dependency) and run its CLI (inventory, check) against itself, without weakening any existing contract or the fail-closed npm publication gate.
success_criteria: SC1: `npm ci && npm run validate` exits 0 on a clean checkout even when a git-ignored stray lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml) sits at the repo root — proof V1 and V2
SC2: ESLint reports 0 errors and 0 warnings, `tsc --noEmit` is clean, and `npm ci` prints no deprecation warning for a direct devDependency — proof V3
SC3: an installed packed tarball runs `l9-meta-injector --help` (exit 0), `inventory .` and `check . --authority <fixture>` inside a fresh temporary git repository — proof V4
SC4: `npm install git+file://<bare clone>#HEAD` succeeds in a temporary consumer and its installed bin runs `inventory .` — proof V5
SC5: CI job `consumer-proof` runs the composite Action from a checkout of a separate fixture repository and passes — proof V6
SC6: every check-run on the PR head is green, including SonarCloud Code Analysis (0 new BUG/VULNERABILITY) and Topology conformance — proof V7 and V8
SC7: `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` prints nothing after `npm run validate` — proof V9
SC8: `npm run check:publication` still reports BLOCKED until a distribution owner approves; no approval field is forged — proof V10

todos.task: ADR-079 + package scripts. Evidence (Context7 /npm/cli/v10.9.9 package-json.md 'Git URLs as Dependencies'): a git dependency is cloned, has ALL dependencies installed, its scripts run and is re-packed whenever any of build, prepare, prepack, preinstall, install, postinstall is defined; npm advises repos shipping pre-built artifacts to define none of them. So: rename script `build` to `compile` and move the `prepack` gate chain into an explicit `release:check` run by prepublishOnly, selfpack, CI smoke and release.yml; update every caller (CI workflows, Makefile, action.yml, docs, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md command text via append) in the same commit. check:dist parity enforcement must remain on every path it covers today except the git-install lifecycle. Update docs/package-contract.json.
